title: Fireboat Station 35 finished below its revised budget and $12.6 million above its first

beats.text: The original fireboat station budget was about $37.8 million.

visual.sub: The bond allocation and the project budget had different scopes

beats.text: The all-source agreement was signed in 2016.
In 2017 Public Works raised the budget to attract bidders.

visual.kicker: The commission saw how the budget rose during design and construction

beats.text: Design changes, steel tariffs and utility work also raised the budget.
The original schedule called for substantial completion in 2020.

visual.kicker: Substantial completion came 517 days after the original contract target

beats.text: The March 2022 report records substantial completion 517 days after that target.
The jury put final actual cost at $50.4 million.

visual.kicker: The jury reported $50.4 million spent against a final $51.1 million budget

beats.text: That was below the revised budget, but $12.6 million above the original.
